coordinate_system.world: COLMAP world frame: arbitrary origin, orientation and scale (up to a similarity)
coordinate_system.camera: x right, y down, z forward (OpenCV convention)
coordinate_system.pose: rotation_cam_from_world and translation map a world point X to the camera frame: Xc = R·X + t
coordinate_system.up_note: Estimated from the average camera 'down' axis; not gravity-calibrated.

scale.note: Structure from motion recovers shape only up to an unknown scale. All coordinates are in arbitrary 'model units'. Distances are NOT metres or feet. Enter a known real distance in the viewer to calibrate a scale for measurements.
